items.original: Club Seniors at GHF — resort-style amenities, senior-friendly classes, and a community of seniors just like you.
items.text: Club Seniors at GHF — resort-style amenities, senior-friendly classes, and a community of seniors just like you.

items.original: Resort-style amenities, classes built for your joints (not against them), and a roomful of friends who'll notice if you miss a Tuesday. Stay strong, stay sharp, stay you.
items.text: Resort-style amenities, classes built for your joints (not against them), and a roomful of friends who'll notice if you miss a Tuesday. Stay strong, stay sharp, stay you.

items.original: Our fitness classes for seniors are taught by a team of experienced instructors. Class formats have lots of repetition, fewer directional changes, simple movements, lower intensities with fun music you are sure to enjoy. Classes are perfect for those with limited mobility.
items.text: Our fitness classes for seniors are taught by a team of experienced instructors. Class formats have lots of repetition, fewer directional changes, simple movements, lower intensities with fun music you are sure to enjoy. Classes are perfect for those with limited mobility.

items.original: On land, you may choose from balance foundations, functional fitness, simply stretch, postural health, balance for beginners, tai chi, and more.
items.text: On land, you may choose from balance foundations, functional fitness, simply stretch, postural health, balance for beginners, tai chi, and more.

items.original: Aqua classes give you an ideal environment for relieving arthritis pain and stiffness, increasing range of motion, strength, and overall confidence — through pain free range of motion.
items.text: Aqua classes give you an ideal environment for relieving arthritis pain and stiffness, increasing range of motion, strength, and overall confidence — through pain free range of motion.

items.original: Choose from aqua yoga, gentle joints, balance foundations, pilates flow H2O, and stretch and tone fitness classes.
items.text: Choose from aqua yoga, gentle joints, balance foundations, pilates flow H2O, and stretch and tone fitness classes.

items.original: Our signature program is the Sit To Be Fit series that focuses on seated exercises for strength, cardio, core, yoga, and flexibility and is ideal for those with limited mobility.

items.original: All classes on the group fitness schedule are included in membership, there is no additional charge.
